purpose: silver_nyc_flights is the cleaned flight-level table of all 166158 NYC departures (EWR, JFK, LGA) for January through June 2013, typed from the landed DECIMAL/VARCHAR bronze into integers and timestamps and stripped of Airbyte capture columns. It feeds on-time-performance analysis, carrier comparisons, and route-level aggregates.
usage: Read one row per scheduled departure, keyed by year, month, day, sched_dep_time, carrier, flight, and origin. Flights that never departed carry is_cancelled true and null dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, and air_time; consumers computing delay statistics must filter is_cancelled or handle nulls deliberately. Times dep_time, sched_dep_time, arr_time, and sched_arr_time are HHMM-encoded integers, not minutes; use time_hour (TIMESTAMP) for time-series joins.
limitations: Nulls are retained, not resolved: about 2.9% of rows lack departure data (dep_time null_rate 0.029388), about 3.3% lack arrival outcomes (arr_delay and air_time null_rate 0.032981), and 0.9% of rows have no tailnum. Arrival-side nulls for flights that departed (arr_time null_rate 0.0307 exceeds the departure null rate) may indicate diverted flights the cleanup does not distinguish. HHMM time columns are kept as integers (including 2400.0 as a max) rather than normalized to clock types, and the declared grain has not yet been verified against the full warehouse.
